src/.main.jsx: React app entry point — renders App with providers (Router, AuthContext, CartContext, SocketContext, QueryClient)
src/.App.jsx: Root component — defines all React Router routes, applies role-based route guards, renders layout shells

assets/.fonts/: Poppins and Inter font files referenced by global CSS
assets/.images/: Static images: logo, placeholder food photo, fallback restaurant image
assets/.icons/: SVG icon assets used across the design system

styles/.tokens.css: CSS custom properties for all design tokens: color-*, font-*, space-*, radius-*, elevation-*
styles/.global.css: Reset, base typography, body background (color-canvas), utility classes
styles/.animations.css: Shared keyframe animations (skeleton shimmer, fade-in, slide-up)

types/.user.types.js: JSDoc/TS-style type definitions mirroring User.model.js: User, SavedAddress, AgentProfile, NotificationPreferences
types/.restaurant.types.js: Restaurant, MenuCategory, MenuItem (with allergen/dietary fields), OperatingHours
types/.order.types.js: Order, OrderItem, StatusHistory — mirrors Order.model.js embeds
types/.payment.types.js: Payment, Refund — mirrors Payment.model.js; no raw card fields
types/.delivery.types.js: Delivery, AssignmentAttempt, AgentLocation — mirrors Delivery.model.js embeds
types/.api.types.js: Shared API envelope types: ApiResponse, PaginatedResponse, ApiError

services/.api.client.js: Axios instance with base URL, JWT Authorization header injection, 401 token-expiry redirect, and global error normalisation
services/.users.service.js: Calls GET/PATCH /users/me, GET/PATCH /users/me/notification-preferences, address sub-resource mutations via PATCH /users/me; admin: GET /users, GET/PATCH /users/:id/status
services/.restaurants.service.js: Calls GET /restaurants (browse/search/geo filter), GET /restaurants/:id (detail + menu); manager: PATCH /restaurants/:id/settings; admin CRUD via /admin/restaurants
services/.menus.service.js: Calls POST/PATCH/DELETE /restaurants/:id/categories and /restaurants/:id/items — all menu mutations through Restaurant aggregate endpoints
services/.cart.service.js: Calls GET /cart, PUT /cart, DELETE /cart — ordering-service cart endpoints
services/.orders.service.js: Calls POST /orders, GET /orders, GET /orders/:id, PATCH /orders/:id/status; admin: GET /admin/orders, GET /admin/orders/:id
services/.deliveries.service.js: Calls POST /deliveries, GET /deliveries/:id, PATCH /deliveries/:id/status, PATCH /deliveries/:id/location; admin: GET /admin/deliveries
services/.disputes.service.js: Calls POST /disputes, GET /disputes/:id; admin resolution via admin.service
services/.admin.service.js: Calls GET /admin/audit-logs, GET/PATCH /admin/platform-config, GET/PATCH /admin/disputes, admin onboarding endpoints
services/.socket.service.js: Initialises Socket.IO client connection to ordering-service; manages order-room subscriptions, agent-location events, and order-status events; authenticates handshake with JWT

hooks/.useAuth.js: Reads AuthContext; exposes user, role, login, logout, isAuthenticated helpers
hooks/.useCart.js: Reads CartContext; exposes cart state, addItem, updateQuantity, removeItem, clearCart, totals
hooks/.useSocket.js: Reads SocketContext; exposes subscribe/unsubscribe to order and delivery rooms
hooks/.useOrderTracking.js: Combines REST polling fallback and socket events to surface live order status and agent location for a given orderId
hooks/.useGeolocation.js: Wraps browser Geolocation API; returns coords, error, loading state
hooks/.useRestaurantSearch.js: Manages search query, filters (cuisine, price range, rating, delivery time), sort, and pagination state; calls restaurants.service
hooks/.useMediaCapture.js: Wraps browser MediaDevices/getUserMedia for proof-of-delivery photo capture (agent app only)
hooks/.usePagination.js: Generic cursor/offset pagination state and fetching helper
hooks/.useForm.js: Lightweight controlled-form state, validation, and submission wrapper
hooks/.useToast.js: Imperative toast notification trigger consumed from ToastContext

context/.AuthContext.jsx: Stores decoded JWT user, role, and auth state; provides login/logout actions; persists token to localStorage
context/.CartContext.jsx: Stores active cart keyed to restaurantId; enforces single-restaurant rule (REQ-14); exposes cart mutations
context/.SocketContext.jsx: Creates and provides the Socket.IO client instance from socket.service; handles reconnection

router/.ProtectedRoute.jsx: Redirects unauthenticated users to the appropriate login; checks role against allowed roles prop
router/.CustomerLayout.jsx: Shell for customer-facing pages: top nav bar (account, help), bottom nav (mobile), warm canvas background
router/.RestaurantLayout.jsx: Shell for restaurant manager portal: sidebar nav, desktop-optimised, real-time order alert badge
router/.AgentLayout.jsx: Shell for delivery agent app: minimal top bar, single-tap action area, high-contrast variant
router/.AdminLayout.jsx: Shell for admin console: sidebar nav with all admin sections, desktop-optimised

auth/.ResetPasswordPage.jsx: Submit new password with token — POST /auth/reset-password (route: /reset-password)

customer/.HomePage.jsx: Restaurant list filtered by customer location/address — GET /restaurants (route: /)
customer/.SearchPage.jsx: Search results with filter and sort controls — GET /restaurants with query params (route: /search)
customer/.RestaurantDetailPage.jsx: Restaurant detail, menu categories, items with allergens — GET /restaurants/:id (route: /restaurants/:id)
customer/.CartPage.jsx: Active cart view with totals, minimum-order check — GET /cart (route: /cart)
customer/.CheckoutPage.jsx: Delivery/pickup selection, address picker, payment method — POST /payments/initiate, POST /orders (route: /checkout)
customer/.OrderDetailPage.jsx: Order detail with live status and agent map — GET /orders/:id, socket events (route: /orders/:id)
customer/.SubmitReviewPage.jsx: 1-5 star rating and text review form — POST /reviews (route: /orders/:id/review)
customer/.AddAddressPage.jsx: New address form with geocoding — PATCH /users/me (route: /profile/addresses/new)

restaurant/.DashboardPage.jsx: KPI summary, incoming order alerts via socket (route: /restaurant/dashboard)
restaurant/.OrdersListPage.jsx: Incoming and active orders with real-time updates (route: /restaurant/orders)
restaurant/.OrderDetailPage.jsx: Order detail with accept/reject/advance status actions — PATCH /orders/:id/status (route: /restaurant/orders/:id)
restaurant/.MenuManagementPage.jsx: List menu categories and items with toggle availability — GET /restaurants/:id (route: /restaurant/menu)
restaurant/.AddMenuItemPage.jsx: New menu item form including allergen/dietary fields — POST /restaurants/:id/items (route: /restaurant/menu/categories/:categoryId/items/new)
restaurant/.RestaurantSettingsPage.jsx: Open/closed toggle, operating hours, delivery radius — PATCH /restaurants/:id/settings (route: /restaurant/settings)
restaurant/.RestaurantReviewsPage.jsx: Read-only list of customer reviews — GET /restaurants/:id/reviews (route: /restaurant/reviews)

agent/.AgentDashboardPage.jsx: Pending job offers with single-tap accept/decline — socket events + PATCH /deliveries/:id/status (route: /agent/dashboard)
agent/.ActiveDeliveryPage.jsx: Active delivery map, single-tap status updates, GPS location ping, proof-of-delivery photo upload — PATCH /deliveries/:id/status, PATCH /deliveries/:id/location (route: /agent/deliveries/:id)
agent/.DeliveryHistoryPage.jsx: Agent past deliveries — GET /deliveries (via admin endpoint or agent-scoped) (route: /agent/deliveries)

admin/.AdminDashboardPage.jsx: Platform-level KPIs — aggregate data from orders, payments, disputes (route: /admin/dashboard)
admin/.RestaurantListPage.jsx: Browse and search all restaurants — GET /admin/restaurants (route: /admin/restaurants)
admin/.UserDetailPage.jsx: User detail and status management — GET/PATCH /admin/users/:id (route: /admin/users/:id)
admin/.OnboardAgentPage.jsx: Create delivery agent account — POST via admin user endpoint (route: /admin/users/agents/new)
admin/.PaymentDetailPage.jsx: Payment detail with refund action — GET /admin/payments/:id, POST /payments/refund (route: /admin/payments/:id)
admin/.DisputeDetailPage.jsx: Dispute detail and resolution with optional refund — PATCH /admin/disputes/:id (route: /admin/disputes/:id)
admin/.ReviewListPage.jsx: All reviews with remove action — GET /admin/reviews, DELETE /reviews/:id (route: /admin/reviews)
admin/.PlatformConfigPage.jsx: Edit commission rate, service fee, default delivery radius — GET/PATCH /admin/platform-config (route: /admin/config)

ui/.Button.jsx: Primary, secondary, ghost, destructive variants; enforces 44×44 px tap target; uses color-primary and radius-md tokens
ui/.Input.jsx: Text input with label, inline error message (color-error), radius-sm, border color-border
ui/.Select.jsx: Dropdown select with consistent token styling
ui/.Badge.jsx: Pill badge using radius-pill and color-secondary / status colors
ui/.Avatar.jsx: Circular user/restaurant avatar with fallback initials
ui/.Card.jsx: Surface card with elevation-1, radius-md, color-surface background
ui/.Modal.jsx: Accessible dialog with radius-lg, elevation-2, focus trap
ui/.Sheet.jsx: Bottom sheet for mobile overlays — radius-lg top corners
ui/.SkeletonLoader.jsx: Animated shimmer placeholder for async content
ui/.ErrorMessage.jsx: Inline field-level error display using color-error
ui/.StarRating.jsx: Interactive and read-only 1–5 star rating widget
ui/.ProgressStepper.jsx: Order status progress bar (Accepted → Preparing → Ready → Out for Delivery → Delivered)

layout/.TopNavBar.jsx: Shared top navigation: logo, account menu, help link — required on every screen
layout/.BottomNavBar.jsx: Mobile bottom navigation for customer app (Home, Search, Orders, Profile)
layout/.Sidebar.jsx: Desktop sidebar used by restaurant manager and admin layouts
layout/.PageContainer.jsx: Max-width wrapper with horizontal padding using space tokens
layout/.SectionHeading.jsx: Consistent section label using font-h2 token

auth/.AuthGuard.jsx: Wraps ProtectedRoute logic as a component for nested use
auth/.RoleGuard.jsx: Renders children only if current user role matches allowed list

restaurant/.RestaurantCard.jsx: Browse-list card: food photo, name, cuisine, rating, delivery time/fee, min order — uses elevation-1, radius-md
restaurant/.RestaurantHero.jsx: Detail page hero banner with food photo and key stats
restaurant/.OpenStatusBadge.jsx: Open/Closed/Temporarily Unavailable badge using status color tokens
restaurant/.DeliveryInfoRow.jsx: Delivery fee, estimated time, minimum order display row

menu/.MenuCategorySection.jsx: Sticky category header with item list
menu/.MenuItemCard.jsx: Item name, description, price, allergen/dietary icons, availability state; disabled when unavailable (REQ-12)
menu/.AllergenBadge.jsx: Small badge for allergen and dietary labels (NFR-5)
menu/.MenuCategoryNav.jsx: Horizontal scrollable category pill navigation on restaurant detail page

cart/.CartItem.jsx: Line item with quantity stepper, remove button, line total
cart/.CartSummary.jsx: Subtotal, delivery fee, taxes, total recalculation display
cart/.MinOrderWarning.jsx: Inline banner showing shortfall when below minimum order (REQ-16)
cart/.CartDrawer.jsx: Slide-in cart panel for desktop views

checkout/.AddressPicker.jsx: Select from saved addresses or add new — uses /users/me data
checkout/.PaymentMethodSelector.jsx: Card, digital wallet, cash-on-delivery options; delegates tokenisation to gateway SDK (REQ-21)

order/.OrderStatusBadge.jsx: Coloured status chip mapped to color-success/warning/error/primary tokens
order/.OrderCard.jsx: Summary card for order history lists
order/.OrderItemsList.jsx: Itemised list of ordered items with quantities and prices
order/.LiveTrackingMap.jsx: Embeds mapping API route polyline and live agent marker; receives coordinates from socket events (REQ-28)

agent/.DeliveryStatusActions.jsx: Minimal-interaction status update buttons for in-progress delivery
agent/.ProofOfDeliveryCapture.jsx: Camera capture component using useMediaCapture hook (REQ-29)

admin/.DataTable.jsx: Generic sortable, searchable, paginated table used across all admin list pages
admin/.StatCard.jsx: KPI metric card for admin and manager dashboards
admin/.DisputeResolutionForm.jsx: Form to record dispute resolution and trigger refund via POST /payments/refund

notifications/.SocketOrderAlert.jsx: Real-time toast triggered by socket order-status events; used in restaurant dashboard (REQ-36)

maps/.MapContainer.jsx: Wrapper around mapping provider embed; accepts polyline and marker props; used by LiveTrackingMap and ActiveDeliveryPage

utils/.formatCurrency.js: Formats numeric amounts to locale currency string
utils/.formatDate.js: Formats ISO date strings to display-friendly labels
utils/.formatDistance.js: Formats metre/km distances from mapping API responses
utils/.orderStatusHelpers.js: Maps Order statusHistory values to display labels and color tokens
utils/.validationSchemas.js: Shared client-side Zod/Yup validation schemas (registration, address, review, checkout)
utils/.geoUtils.js: Coordinate distance helpers; converts browser Geolocation coords for API requests
utils/.tokenStorage.js: localStorage helpers for JWT read/write/clear (used by AuthContext)
utils/.errorParser.js: Normalises API error envelope to user-facing message strings

config/.env.js: Reads and exports import.meta.env / process.env variables: API base URL, socket URL, mapping API key (public)
config/.queryClient.js: React Query (TanStack Query) client configuration: stale times, retry policy, error handling
config/.constants.js: App-wide constants: ORDER_STATUSES array, CUISINE_TYPES list, MAX_CART_ITEMS, role names

public/.index.html: HTML shell with font preconnects (Google Fonts: Poppins, Inter) and root div
public/.manifest.json: Web app manifest for mobile browser installation

package.json: React app dependencies: react, react-dom, react-router-dom, axios, socket.io-client, @tanstack/react-query, zod, vite
vite.config.js: Vite build config: dev proxy to API gateway, path aliases (@/ → src/)
